questions.q: At which institution does All Might take a teaching job?
questions.why: He becomes a teacher at U.A. High, the school where his successor studies.

questions.q: Which Quirk does All Might wield, passing it on to his successor?
questions.why: All Might is the eighth holder of One For All, the power he later hands to Izuku Midoriya.

questions.q: Who becomes All Might's successor and the ninth holder of his Quirk?
questions.why: All Might hands his power to Izuku Midoriya, whom he picks after the boy tries to rescue Bakugo.

questions.q: Which hero mentored the young Toshinori and taught him to smile?
questions.why: Nana Shimura believed smiling people are the strongest and passed that creed on to her student.

questions.q: All Might is which numbered holder of the Quirk he passes on?
questions.why: He is the eighth user; Izuku Midoriya becomes the ninth.

questions.q: Which two heroes did Kohei Horikoshi say inspired All Might's design?
questions.why: Horikoshi drew on Superman and Captain America, and the heavy shading made the front-facing pose hard to draw.

questions.q: Who voices All Might in the Japanese anime?
questions.why: Kenta Miyake plays All Might in the Japanese anime, while Christopher Sabat voices him in English.

questions.q: Which company animates the My Hero Academia TV anime?
questions.why: Bones adapted the manga, with the first season airing from April to June 2016.

questions.q: Before becoming a series, My Hero Academia began as a one-shot in which magazine?
questions.why: Horikoshi revisited his one-shot My Hero, printed in Akamaru Jump, after an earlier series was cancelled.

questions.q: Which top hero calls All Might his longtime rival?
questions.why: Enji Todoroki, Endeavor, resents but respects All Might as the figure he has always chased.
